title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics - enhanced summaries, runbook linking, and telemetry
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Improvements to on-call auto-diagnostics: more compact summaries, explicit runbook linking, and enhanced telemetry for troubleshooting. No breaking changes.
description: Motivation: on-call engineers have asked for more concise auto-diagnostics and better, deterministic links to runbooks when the incident-bot posts a summary to the oncall channel. The current long-form diagnostic payload is useful but noisy during high-alert bursts; operators want a compact summary with quick links to runbooks and a single click path to collect deeper context. This PR implements three coordinated improvements: 1) compact summary formatter that extracts the minimal triage fields (symptom, impacted services, top 3 suspects, suggested next steps) and surfaces a single prioritized runbook link when available; 2) runbook linking improvements that prefer canonical runbooks from the SLO toolkit and fall back to team-runbooks with a deterministic scoring heuristic; 3) telemetry/trace events emitted for each autodiagnostic run to allow correlation between oncall posts and subsequent remediation actions. Changes are backwards-compatible: the full diagnostic payload is still available via a "details" button in the chat message. The PR also adds unit + integration tests and docs for the incident-bot CLI flag (--compact-autodiag) that enables the compact view for oncall posts. Summary of user-facing behaviour: when --compact-autodiag is enabled, incident-bot will post a short 4-line triage summary and a single prioritized runbook link; the full diagnostic JSON remains downloadable for debugging. Linked work: ENG-4123, SRE-209, support ticket SUP-1187.

notes_on_testing: Integration test validates compact message shape and deterministic runbook selection under randomized inputs; unit tests cover formatter edge cases and redaction paths. CI shows green for unit/integration and linting after two reruns.
observability_changes: Adds telemetry events: incident_autodiag.started, incident_autodiag.runbook_selected, incident_autodiag.posted with metadata tags (org, service, diag_id). Events are emitted through existing telemetry pipeline with PII redaction.
rollback_plan: If issues observed post-merge, toggle --compact-autodiag default to false and release a patch; telemetry events are additive and safe to disable.
user_impact: Low risk: new compact summary behind CLI flag (default disabled for hosted customers during initial rollout). Improves on-call signal-to-noise when enabled.
